contentReview.behaviorReview: Uses current/old cache membership to preserve stored undefined, original expiry deletion/notification, moveToRecent on old hits, and normal set for default maxAge on computed misses. Thrown factory leaves absent key uninserted.
contentReview.retainedTestsReview: All original runtime and tsd regression cases retained.

requiredRegressionReview.evidence: Old-generation stored undefined hit never calls factory; several inserts force next generation, making missing recency promotion observable.

Expired entry is observed without deletion via expiresIn, factory count/key/returned value and one eviction checked. Reinserted TTL only checked as >0, which also accepts Infinity; no upper bound, finite check or later expiry proves default TTL. Same diagnostic of missing finite TTL prepared.
Same thrown Error returned and no insertion; object key is strictly passed to factory and two caches retain distinct object values.

contentReview.typesReview: Typed key inference and ValueType return via tsd, with invalid factory string return rejected for numeric cache.
contentReview.docsReview: README and declarations explain synchronous compute, hit recency, no factory on hits and default maxAge.
